import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from readout import write_layer11_readout
F=np.load('feats.npz'); y=F['y']
cfg=np.load('stash_cfg.npz'); S=cfg['S']
D=np.load('featsS.npz'); C=D['C9'].astype(np.float64); M=D['M9'].astype(np.float64)
nonS=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),S)
ch=nonS[np.argsort(C[:,nonS].var(0))[:8]]
keep=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),ch); Mcols=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),S)
wc,ws,lam=0.85,1.0,500.0
Ck=C[:,keep]; Cc=Ck-Ck.mean(1,keepdims=True)
muC=Cc.mean(0); sdC=Cc.std(0)+1e-9; muM=M[:,Mcols].mean(0); sdM=M[:,Mcols].std(0)+1e-9
wv=np.where(np.isin(keep,S),ws,wc)
Z=np.c_[wv*(Cc-muC)/sdC,(M[:,Mcols]-muM)/sdM]
Y=np.eye(8)[y]-1/8; zm=Z.mean(0); Zc=Z-zm
a=np.linalg.solve(Zc@Zc.T+lam*np.eye(len(Z)),Y-Y.mean(0)); Wt=Zc.T@a
nk=len(keep); Wc=Wt[:nk]; Wm=Wt[nk:]
B=(wv[:,None]*Wc/sdC[:,None]).T
A=np.zeros((8,768)); A[:,Mcols]=(Wm/sdM[:,None]).T
b=Y.mean(0)-zm@Wt-(wv*muC/sdC)@Wc-(muM/sdM)@Wm
B=B-B.mean(1,keepdims=True)
logit=Ck@B.T+M@A.T+b
ref=Z@Wt+(Y.mean(0)-zm@Wt)
print('max diff vs ridge',np.abs(logit-ref).max(),'in-sample acc',(logit.argmax(1)==y).mean())
R=dict(B=B,A=A,b=b,ch=ch,keep=keep)
np.savez('readout_S.npz',**R)
hm=C[:,ch].mean(0)
write_layer11_readout(R, save_edit, c=100.0, s=1.0, hch_mean=hm, layer=9)
np.save('offline_logits_S.npy',logit)
print('B abs max',np.abs(B).max(),'A abs max',np.abs(A).max(), 'logit std',logit.std())
